name: simlock
description: Control plane for iOS simulators and Android emulators.
author: Szymon Chmal <szymon@chmal.it> (V3RON)

scripts.build: pnpm run build:daemon && pnpm run build:ui && pnpm run build:capture
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:timing && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:e2e && vitest run --project e2e --tags-filter='!slow'
scripts.test:e2e:slow: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:e2e && vitest run --project e2e --no-file-parallelism --reporter=default --reporter=./e2e/progress-reporter.ts --tags-filter='!physical && !physical-manual'
scripts.test:e2e:physical: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:e2e && vitest run --project e2e --no-file-parallelism --reporter=default --reporter=./e2e/progress-reporter.ts --tags-filter='physical'
scripts.test:e2e:physical-manual: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:e2e && vitest run --project e2e --no-file-parallelism --reporter=default --reporter=./e2e/progress-reporter.ts --tags-filter='physical-manual'
scripts.test:console: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:e2e && playwright test
scripts.test:real-proxy: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:e2e && playwright test --config playwright.real-proxy.config.ts
scripts.typecheck:e2e: pnpm run build:ui && pnpm run build:capture && pnpm run typecheck:e2e:types
scripts.typecheck:e2e:types: pnpm run build:daemon && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.typecheck.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile node_modules/.cache/tsc/e2e.tsbuildinfo
scripts.lint: oxlint src e2e ui && depcruise src e2e ui --ignore-known
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:e2e && pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:comments && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test
